lede: The day's loudest story was a succession rumor at the top of the chip industry. A Hacker News post reporting that Nvidia is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang pulled 1,155 comments, his Wikipedia page drew 341,625 views, and a Polymarket book on whether his resignation or removal would be announced by its November 11 deadline crossed six million dollars in 24-hour volume. The turn is in the odds: even as the feeds lit up, that market put Yes at 0.05 percent and No at 99.95 percent. Underneath it, the quieter currents ran through gaming, where a Rockstar pre-load video for Grand Theft Auto VI passed 9.6 million views and Counter-Strike 2 again topped Steam with more than 1.2 million concurrent players.

throughlines.title: Jensen Huang announced resignation or removal by November 11, 2026?
throughlines.gist: A Hacker News report that Nvidia is preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang drew 1,155 comments and pushed his Wikipedia page to 341,625 views, yet the Polymarket book on a formal resignation or removal by the deadline held No at 99.95 percent.

throughlines.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: Pre-Load Now
throughlines.gist: Rockstar's Pre-Load Now spot for Grand Theft Auto VI passed 9.6 million views on YouTube while Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced held 67,251 concurrent players on Steam, the long wait showing up on two feeds at once.

throughlines.title: Mississippi elects Democrat Scott Colom as state's first Black US senator since Reconstruction
throughlines.gist: The Associated Press called Mississippi for Democrat Scott Colom, the state's first Black US senator since Reconstruction, a result that surfaced on both Lemmy and Mastodon.
